title: Introduction to resumeMatchR
text: resumeMatchR simple R package designed help users compare resumes job descriptions using basic text analysis tools. package includes functions : counting keywords text finding missing skills resume calculating simple similarity score resume job description vignette demonstrates use main functions included package.

title: Introduction to resumeMatchR
text: package includes sample dataset called resume_sample_data. Load dataset: Sample Resume Job Description Dataset dataset contains: - candidate names - target roles - resume text - job descriptions
code: data(resume_sample_data)  knitr::kable(   resume_sample_data,   caption = "Sample Resume and Job Description Dataset" )

title: Introduction to resumeMatchR
text: count_keywords() function counts many times selected keywords appear piece text. useful checking whether important skills appear resume.
code: count_keywords(   resume_sample_data$resume_text[1],   c("Python", "SQL", "Tableau") ) #>   keyword count #> 1  Python     1 #> 2     SQL     1 #> 3 Tableau     0

title: Introduction to resumeMatchR
text: missing_skills() function identifies required skills missing resume. can help users improve resumes identifying missing keywords skills.

title: Introduction to resumeMatchR
text: text_similarity_simple() function calculates simple overlap score resume job description. similarity score ranges 0 1: - values closer 1 indicate higher similarity - values closer 0 indicate lower similarity
